response.overview: “Why are you here?”  A wife (Ji-yeon) is left alone after losing her husband (Jin-seong) in a car accident caused by carelessness.  Despite being filled with an unbearable sense of loss and seeming to be having a hard time, Ji-yeon is rather calm.  After completing the funeral and burial process, Ji-yeon leaves her life in Seoul behind and goes down to Jeju.  One day, Jin-seong’s mistress (Seung-hee) appears in front of Ji-yeon.  A story where the truth that had been hidden until then is revealed as complex emotions such as sadness, anger, despair, and regret explode, crossing between the present and the past.
response.title: Disclose
